name: Djed Stablecoin
oneLiner: DJED is COTI's overcollateralized Cardano dollar stablecoin, minted against ADA reserves while SHEN holders absorb reserve volatility within a target band.
collateral: ADA reserves held by the Cardano Djed protocol, with SHEN reserve-coin holders absorbing surplus reserve volatility
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized Cardano stablecoin where DJED can be minted and burned against ADA while SHEN maintains the reserve ratio band

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit No retained: reviewed metadata describes on-chain or overcollateralized collateral mechanics and does not identify a direct holder-balance blacklist or freeze surface on the issued token.

mintAuthority.summary: DJED is minted and burned permissionlessly against a shared ADA reserve pool by a formally verified autonomous smart-contract bank, with SHEN reserve-coin holders absorbing volatility; minting is gated by the 400%-800% reserve-ratio band rather than a per-user CDP, and COTI/IOG operate the contracts and oracle.

controls.label: Djed autonomous bank contract (reserve mint/burn)
controls.capDescription: DJED mint allowed only while the ADA reserve ratio stays at or above 400% (and within the 400%-800% band); mint price set by oracle ADA/USD.
controls.evidence: The Djed smart contract autonomously mints/burns DJED against the shared ADA reserve, forbidding new DJED minting below a 400% reserve ratio; SHEN absorbs surplus reserve volatility.

controls.label: COTI / IOG operator (oracle and parameters)
controls.evidence: Djed is designed by IOG and issued/operated by COTI, which supplies the ADA/USD oracle feed and protocol parameters; coin metadata flags single-entity governance.

review.evidence: Djed is a formally verified autonomous reserve/seigniorage stablecoin (not a per-user CDP): DJED is minted/burned against a shared ADA reserve under a 400%-800% reserve-ratio rule, with SHEN as the reserve coin and COTI as operator/oracle.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Autonomous-bank reserve-ratio mechanism confirmed from COTI/Djed materials; on-chain script governance/oracle admin not independently resolved on Cardano.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain Djed parameter/oracle admin authority and any upgrade path on Cardano; the mint mechanism is a reserve-coin model rather than a classic per-user CDP.

reserves.name: ADA reserves in the Cardano Djed contract
